def transform(grid):
    from collections import Counter, defaultdict, deque

    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    wall = next(v for v, _ in counts.most_common() if v != background)

    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    seen = [[False] * w for _ in range(h)]

    for sr in range(h):
        for sc in range(w):
            if seen[sr][sc] or grid[sr][sc] == wall:
                continue

            q = deque([(sr, sc)])
            seen[sr][sc] = True
            cells = []
            while q:
                r, c = q.popleft()
                cells.append((r, c))
                for nr, nc in ((r-1, c), (r+1, c), (r, c-1), (r, c+1)):
                    if (0 <= nr < h and 0 <= nc < w and not seen[nr][nc]
                            and grid[nr][nc] != wall):
                        seen[nr][nc] = True
                        q.append((nr, nc))

            top = min(r for r, c in cells)
            bottom = max(r for r, c in cells)
            left = min(c for r, c in cells)
            right = max(c for r, c in cells)

            seed_colors = defaultdict(Counter)
            for r, c in cells:
                color = grid[r][c]
                if color != background and color != wall:
                    depth = min(r-top, bottom-r, c-left, right-c)
                    seed_colors[depth][color] += 1

            if not seed_colors:
                continue

            max_seed_depth = max(seed_colors)
            palette = []
            for depth in range(max_seed_depth + 1):
                if depth in seed_colors:
                    palette.append(seed_colors[depth].most_common(1)[0][0])
                else:
                    palette.append(background)

            for r, c in cells:
                depth = min(r-top, bottom-r, c-left, right-c)
                out[r][c] = palette[depth % len(palette)]

    return out

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(x for row in grid for x in row)
    bg = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    wall = max((c for c in counts if c != bg), key=lambda c: counts[c])

    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    seen = [[False] * w for _ in range(h)]

    for sr in range(h):
        for sc in range(w):
            if seen[sr][sc] or grid[sr][sc] == wall:
                continue

            q = deque([(sr, sc)])
            seen[sr][sc] = True
            cells = []
            markers = []

            while q:
                r, c = q.popleft()
                cells.append((r, c))
                if grid[r][c] != bg and grid[r][c] != wall:
                    markers.append((r, c, grid[r][c]))
                for nr, nc in ((r-1,c), (r+1,c), (r,c-1), (r,c+1)):
                    if 0 <= nr < h and 0 <= nc < w and not seen[nr][nc] and grid[nr][nc] != wall:
                        seen[nr][nc] = True
                        q.append((nr, nc))

            if not markers:
                continue

            r0 = min(r for r, c in cells)
            r1 = max(r for r, c in cells)
            c0 = min(c for r, c in cells)
            c1 = max(c for r, c in cells)

            corners = [
                (r0, c0, 1, 1), (r0, c1, 1, -1),
                (r1, c0, -1, 1), (r1, c1, -1, -1)
            ]

            def corner_score(corner):
                cr, cc, dr, dc = corner
                vals = []
                for r, c, _ in markers:
                    a, b = (r-cr)*dr, (c-cc)*dc
                    vals.append(abs(a-b))
                return (sum(vals), min((r-cr)*dr + (c-cc)*dc for r,c,_ in markers))

            corner = min(corners, key=corner_score)
            cr, cc, dr, dc = corner
            markers.sort(key=lambda p: ((p[0]-cr)*dr + (p[1]-cc)*dc, p[0], p[1]))
            colors = [p[2] for p in markers]
            outer = colors[0]

            for r, c in cells:
                depth = min(r-r0, r1-r, c-c0, c1-c)
                out[r][c] = colors[depth] if depth < len(colors) else outer

    return out

    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)

    seen = [[False] * w for _ in range(h)]

    for sr in range(h):
        for sc in range(w):
            if seen[sr][sc] or grid[sr][sc] == wall:
                continue
            q = deque([(sr, sc)])
            seen[sr][sc] = True
            cells, marks = [], []
            while q:
                r, c = q.popleft()
                cells.append((r, c))
                if grid[r][c] != bg:
                    marks.append((r, c, grid[r][c]))
                for nr, nc in ((r-1,c), (r+1,c), (r,c-1), (r,c+1)):
                    if 0 <= nr < h and 0 <= nc < w and not seen[nr][nc] and grid[nr][nc] != wall:
                        seen[nr][nc] = True
                        q.append((nr, nc))
            if not marks:
                continue

            r0 = min(r for r, c in cells)
            r1 = max(r for r, c in cells)
            c0 = min(c for r, c in cells)
            c1 = max(c for r, c in cells)
            corners = [(r0,c0,1,1), (r0,c1,1,-1),
                       (r1,c0,-1,1), (r1,c1,-1,-1)]

            def score(k):
                cr, cc, dr, dc = k
                vals = [((r-cr)*dr, (c-cc)*dc) for r,c,_ in marks]
                return (sum(abs(a-b) for a,b in vals),
                        sum(a+b for a,b in vals))

            cr, cc, dr, dc = min(corners, key=score)
            marks.sort(key=lambda p: ((p[0]-cr)*dr + (p[1]-cc)*dc, p[0], p[1]))
            colors = [p[2] for p in marks]

            for r, c in cells:
                depth = min(r-r0, r1-r, c-c0, c1-c)
                out[r][c] = colors[depth] if depth < len(colors) else colors[0]

    return out
